title: DEV-LOOP-01 Canonical Queue and Safe Runner Integration
purpose: Connect the agent-neutral Development Control Plane with the canonical Durable Job Store and background worker polling loop to enable safe, isolated background task execution.
problem: Development task sessions are executed manually or via ad-hoc processes. Integrating control plane task sessions with the durable job store and background worker loop ensures deterministic background execution, process isolation, and durable job tracking.

included: Bridge adapter between Development Control Plane sessions and Durable Job Store
Safe runner execution wrapper with dirty-tree checks and timeout enforcement
CLI entry point scripts/dev-loop.js for enqueuing, running, and status inspection
Acceptance test suite scripts/test-dev-loop.js verifying job lifecycle and outcome recording
Integration with dev:status command and control plane validation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Development session tasks can be enqueued as schema-valid durable jobs into Durable Job Store
Background worker polling loop claims and executes queued dev jobs safely
Safe runner enforces timeout limits and dirty-tree safety checks before task execution
Job completion and failure outcomes are durably recorded in job store and session metadata
CLI entry point scripts/dev-loop.js supports --enqueue, --run-next, and --status commands
